[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided steps to schedule a team meeting:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Identify the purpose and desired outcomes of the meeting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Determine the required attendees and their availability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Choose a date and time that works for the majority of the team.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Set a specific agenda for the meeting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Block out the time in the calendar and send out invitations.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Personalize the message.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Clearly state the purpose.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Show, don't tell.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Add value.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. End with a clear call-to-action.
